description: This file is a Perl module implementing an interface to Git, providing methods for executing Git commands, managing repositories, handling credentials, and processing Git objects and configurations.

classes.name: Git::Error::Command
classes.description: Exception class for errors returned from external Git commands, containing command line, exit code, and output.

methods.name: repository
methods.description: Constructs a new Git repository object, determining repository and working copy paths.

methods.name: command
methods.description: Executes a Git command, returning output as string or list of lines.

methods.name: command_oneline
methods.description: Executes a Git command and returns the first line of output.

methods.name: command_output_pipe
methods.description: Executes a command and returns a pipe to read its output.

methods.name: command_input_pipe
methods.description: Executes a command and returns a pipe for input.

methods.name: command_close_pipe
methods.description: Closes a pipe returned by command_output_pipe or command_input_pipe.

methods.name: command_bidi_pipe
methods.description: Executes a command and returns pipes for bidirectional communication.

methods.name: command_close_bidi_pipe
methods.description: Closes pipes from command_bidi_pipe and waits for process termination.

methods.name: version
methods.description: Returns the current Git version.

methods.name: exec_path
methods.description: Returns the path to Git's executable directory.

methods.name: html_path
methods.description: Returns the path to Git's HTML documentation.

methods.name: get_tz_offset
methods.description: Returns timezone offset from GMT for a given time.

methods.name: get_record
methods.description: Reads a record from a filehandle with specified separator.

methods.name: prompt
methods.description: Prompts user for input, supporting GIT_ASKPASS and SSH_ASKPASS.

methods.name: repo_path
methods.description: Returns the repository path for a repository object.

methods.name: wc_path
methods.description: Returns the working copy path for a repository object.

methods.name: wc_subdir
methods.description: Returns the subdirectory within the working copy.

methods.name: wc_chdir
methods.description: Changes the working copy subdirectory.

methods.name: config
methods.description: Retrieves a configuration variable.

methods.name: config_bool
methods.description: Retrieves a boolean configuration variable.

methods.name: config_path
methods.description: Retrieves a path configuration variable.

methods.name: config_int
methods.description: Retrieves an integer configuration variable.

methods.name: config_regexp
methods.description: Retrieves configuration keys matching a regex.

methods.name: get_colorbool
methods.description: Determines if color should be used for a named operation.

methods.name: get_color
methods.description: Retrieves color escape sequence for a slot.

methods.name: remote_refs
methods.description: Returns refs from a remote repository.

methods.name: ident
methods.description: Retrieves and parses ident info for author or committer.

methods.name: ident_person
methods.description: Returns name and email from ident info.

methods.name: hash_object
methods.description: Computes SHA1 hash of a file considering it as a Git object.

methods.name: hash_and_insert_object
methods.description: Computes SHA1 hash and inserts object into database.

methods.name: cat_blob
methods.description: Outputs blob content to a filehandle.

methods.name: port_num
methods.description: Converts port name or number to numeric port.

methods.name: credential_read
methods.description: Reads credential key-value pairs from a filehandle.

methods.name: credential_write
methods.description: Writes credential key-value pairs to a filehandle.

methods.name: credential
methods.description: Handles credential operations: fill, approve, reject.
